verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents audit trails, one-click case export, CSV exports, file attachments with renaming, and 90-day periodic case reviews. None of it describes configuring or verifying data retention periods or deletion behavior for customer or investigation data. The 90-day review is a re-review workflow, not retention, and exports and audit trails are adjacent features, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure or verify retention and deletion behavior for customer and investigation data
